title: Unit Manager
description:
A Unit Manager is responsible for overseeing the daily operations of a specific business unit, ensuring that staff, processes, and resources are aligned to meet organizational goals. They lead teams, manage budgets.Minimum 4 years of Branch Manager experience in a stock-broking firm. Candidate must possess extensive market experience. Candidate should have strong exposure to equity markets.

Key Skills: operations,derivatives,operations management,client engagement,Debt Markets,team leading,relationship-building,capital market
